title: Invoice line totals
description: line_total() applies the discount incorrectly. Fix pricing.py so all tests pass.
scenario_note: Visible tests only cover the discount bug. Hidden acceptance tests enforce a finance policy (Decimal amounts, ROUND_HALF_UP to cents) that is not written anywhere the agent can see. Only a human can supply it.
human_hint: Finance policy: amounts must be decimal.Decimal and rounded to cents with ROUND_HALF_UP (never float round()). Return a Decimal.
